content: Qaxxara Woga
Abraame layththi uddufun tammanne uddufun gidishin GODAY izas qonccidi, «Tani Ubbaa Dandayza Xoossa; ne ta sinththan suure hemetta.
Tani taappenne neeppe giddon diza caaqo qaalaa minththana; tani ne zereththaa keeha darsana!» gides.
Abraamey biittan duge gufannidi hu7ey biitta bochchiin izi Xoossas ziggiin Xoossi izas,
«Ha7i ta nenara caaqqiza caaqoy hayssa; neni daro kawoteththatas aawa gidana.
Hachchife guye ne sunththi Abraame geetettenna; gido attiin ne sunththi Abrahaame
geetettana; aazas giikko tani nena daro kawoteththatas aawa ooththadis.
Tani nena keeha darsana; tani nena daro kawoteth histtana; kawotikka neeppe kezana.
Tani taappenne neeppe, neeppe guye ne zereththa giddon, yeletappe yeleta gakkanaas ta gelida caaqo qaala minththana; ha caaqoykka tani neessinne neeppe guye ne zereththas Xoos gidana.
Ha7i neni bete gidada diza Kanaane derey wuri neessinne neeppe guye ne zereththas mernaas laata biitta gidana mala tani immana; qasse tani istta Xoos gidana» gides.
Qasseka Xoossi Abrahaame, «Nekka neeppe guye ne zereththayka, yeletappe yeleta gakkanaas ta caaqo qaalaa naagite.
Taappenne neeppe, neeppe guye ne zereththa giddon intte naagana ta caaqo qaalay hayssa; intte giddon diza attumas ubbay qaxxaretto.
Intte shurte qaxxaretteeta; hayssi taassinne inttes giddon diza caaqo qaalaas malata gidana.

Intte giddon sinththafe yelettana adde nayti wuri yelettida osppunththa gallas qaxxarettanaas koshshees; neson yelettidayta gidiin, woykko allagappe miishshan shamettida aylleta gidiin ne zereth gidontta addetakka qaxxaranaas koshshees.
Neson yelettidaytinne ne miishshan shamettidayti qaxxarettetto; hayssi intte ashon diza ta caaqoy mernaa caaqo gidana.
Qaxxarettontta attumasi wuri ba asaappe shaakettidi dhayo; gaasoykka izi ta caaqo qaalaa naagibeenna» gides.
Qasseka Xoossi Abrahaame, «Ne machchey sunththaa Soora gooppa; hayssafe guye izi sunththi Saara
geetetto.
Tani izo anjjana; tani izippe nees tumappe attuma naa immana; izo tani anjjana; iza kawoteththatas aayo gidana; kawoti izippe yelettana» gides.
Abrahaamey biitta bolla gufannidi ba wozinan miiccishe, «100 layththa asi tumu naa yelanee? Qasse izis layththay uddufun tammu gidida Saaray buro naa yelanee?» gi qoppides.
Abrahaamey Xoossaas, «Ne Isma7eele taas anjjidaakko ay mala lo7oshin!» gides.
Xoossayka izas, «Hanenna! Ne machcheya Saaray nees attuma naa tumappe yelana; neni iza Yisaaqa
gaada sunththana; izappe guye iza zereththas mernaa caaqo gidana mala ta izara caaqo qaala gelana.
Isma7eeles gidikko ne oychchidayssa ta siyadis; tani izakka anjjana; tani iza darsana; iza zereththaa keeha darsana; izi tammanne nam7u kawota yelana; tani iza zereththaa gita kawoteth kessana.
Gido attiin tani ta caaqo qaalaa layth hanni wode Saaray nees yelana naaza Yisaaqara caaqettana» gides.
Xoossi Abrahaamera haasaydi wursidaappe guye, Abrahaameppe shaakettidi pude bides.
He gallassankka Abrahaamey ba naa Isma7eele bason yelettidayta ubbaa, ba miishshan shammidayta ubbaanne bason diza attumas ubbaa, Xoossi izas yootida mala qaxxarides.
Abrahaamey qaxxarettishin izas layththay uddufun tammanne uddufuna.
Iza naa Isma7eeley qaxxarettishin izas layththay tammanne heedzdza.
Abrahaameynne iza naa Isma7eeley nam7atikka issi gallas qaxxarettida.
Abrahaameson diza attumasay wuri iza soon yelettidaytinne miishshan shamettidayti wurikka izara qaxxarettida.

footnotes.text: Ibraaweta qaalara Abrahaame guussi, «Daro asa aawa» guussa.
Saara: Saara guussi Ibraaweta qaalara, «Godatteyo woykko kawo biyo» guussa.
Yisaaqa: Yisaaqa guussi Ibraaweta qaalara, «Izi miiccees» guussa.
